identity.description: An attacker modifies the Windows registry to establish persistence by adding a malicious executable to the Run key. Cortex detects this behavior as an uncommon login item modification. The attack involves registry manipulation and process execution.

techniques.name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon login item persistency was registered or modified
biocs.description: Detection of registry modifications to the Run key by non-standard processes
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'reg.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'Run'
| filter action_file_path contains 'CurrentVersion'

abiocs.name: Uncommon login item persistency behavior
abiocs.description: Detection of non-standard process modifying Run key with uncommon persistence pattern
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'reg.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'Run'
| filter action_file_path contains 'CurrentVersion'
| filter not actor_process_image_name in ('explorer.exe', 'svchost.exe', 'cmd.exe')

xql_queries.name: Hunt for Run key registry modifications
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'reg.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'Run'
| filter action_file_path contains 'CurrentVersion'
| comp count() by actor_process_image_name, action_file_path
